definitions.gloss: to imagine, to picture, to fancy
definitions.explanation: To form a mental image or concept of something not present or not experienced.

examples.japanese: {将来|しょうらい}の{自分|じぶん}を{想像|そうぞう}してみてください。
examples.english: Try to imagine your future self.

examples.japanese: {想像|そうぞう}もできないほど{大変|たいへん}だった。
examples.english: It was more difficult than I could have imagined.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}が{怒|おこ}っている{姿|すがた}は{想像|そうぞう}しにくい。
examples.english: It's hard to imagine him getting angry.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{想像|そうぞう}する (imagine X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {想像|そうぞう}している = 'is imagining.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{想像|そうぞう}に{難|かた}くない (easy to imagine)
・{想像|そうぞう}を{絶|ぜっ}する (beyond imagination)
・{想像|そうぞう}どおり (as imagined)
・{想像|そうぞう}{以上|いじょう}に (more than imagined)

SIMILAR WORDS: {創造|そうぞう}する (same pronunciation) means 'to create' - note the different kanji.
